text:
Maya: AM async — quick Q1 roadmap handoff updates. What I did: finalized the embed-cache TTL spec, linked PR and figma, updated acceptance criteria. Blockers: waiting on infra validation for the rollout config (Arjun) and a CI GPU allocation flake. Today: finalize rollout doc, pair with Arjun on canary config, address the perf regression in feature flags. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321

Arjun: Saw the spec, looks good overall. Infra validation is in progress but I need the exact config schema names (fields) to wire the validation. Also noticed a CI flake in ded-server e2e that's blocking a clean run.

Maya: schema snippet below — please pull into the spec if it helps:
```
cache_ttl: 3600
max_staleness_ratio: 0.1
fallback_model: 'redwood-mistral-v1'
canary_percentage: 5
rollback_on_latency_pct: 10
```
CI flake: appears to be a GPU allocation race; Ben is looking into it.

Priya: QA here — plan to run smoke and acceptance tests on dedicated staging once the rollout doc is published. Can you share expected SLO numbers and test payloads? Need explicit A/B acceptance criteria.

Maya: SLOs: p95 < 120ms for 512 tokens, p99 < 300ms. Acceptance: no >5% quality drop on our eval set + latency guards. Test payloads in drive: https://drive.redwood/workflows/embed-cache-smoke.json

Ben: I can triage the GPU allocation race today. Quick ask re: canary — recommend starting at 5% traffic, then 20% if green. Need a rollback trigger (latency or error-rate threshold).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for branch embed-cache/rollout at 05:30 UTC (canary_id: cny-2026-03-17-005).

Priya: 5% sounds fine. Proposed rollback guard: if mean latency increases >10% vs baseline OR error rate >0.5% over 5min, auto-roll back.

Arjun: I'll add the exact schema to the spec and push a small patch to the PR (expecting to push in ~2h). Agree we should deprioritize the rerank micro-opt until after this rollout — it adds complexity to the model weights path.

Maya: Agreed — move rerank micro-opt to next sprint so it doesn't block launch. Prioritize canary + QA signoff first.

Ben: Ping @data-team for a quick eval run on the canary model variant; need to ensure no regressed outputs at 5% traffic. @Priya can you coordinate?

Priya: Tagging @data-team (cc @Arjun) — can schedule eval later today after Arjun's patch lands.

Maya: TL;DR / actions:
- @Arjun add schema to spec and push patch
- @Ben investigate & fix GPU CI flake (post patch)
- @Priya schedule smoke & acceptance tests after canary
- I'll update rollout doc and set canary to 5% with rollback triggers above

Anything else?

Arjun: No other blockers from infra side, working on schema now. ETA EOD.

Ben: EOD for GPU fix, I'll post the patch link in thread when done.

Priya: QA scheduled for 10:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post results in this thread.

Maya: Thanks all — I'll post the final rollout doc once updated. :thumbsup:
